title: 九下 · 综合笔试训练卷
scope: 中考阶段综合笔试能力：复杂句关系、词形、主旨与证据范围、观点表达；结构为本项目自编。
language: 表达“只有老师陪同才能进”：You cannot enter the room [[1]] a teacher is with you.
unless 表除非；除非老师在场，否则不能进入。
although 表虽然，不能表达给定的进入条件。
because 表原因，不对应“只有……才能”的条件。
I wonder [[1]] for the next meeting.
wonder 后的宾语从句用陈述语序，should 后接原形 prepare。
此处不能沿用直接疑问句的倒装语序。
The guide [[1]] helped us yesterday is a student volunteer.
先行词 guide 指人，关系词在从句中作 helped 的主语，用 who。
whose 表所属，不能直接作这里的 helped 主语。
where 表地点关系，不适合指人的主语缺口。
Each of the two plans [[1]] one important detail.
中心词 Each 按单数处理，用 includes。
不能被 of 后的 plans 误导为复数谓语 include。
including 不能独立作这个完整句子的限定谓语。
These instructions should [[1]] before the activity starts.
说明文字承受核对动作，should be checked 是情态动词的被动结构。
check 是主动结构，不能表达说明被核对。
be checking 是主动进行形式，不是这里的被动。
Please make your conclusion as [[1]] as the evidence allows.
make 后的宾语补足语描述 conclusion，用形容词 accurate。
accurately 是副词，不能作此处描述 conclusion 的形容词。
accuracy 是名词，不符合这里的形容词比较结构。
We have not [[1]] the final date yet.
have not 后接过去分词 confirmed，yet 与尚未确认的意思一致。
confirm 原形不能直接构成这个现在完成时。
confirming 不是 have 后所需的过去分词。
We kept copies of the notes [[1]] we could check the source later.
后面是有主语和谓语的分句，so that 引出保存副本的目的。
because of 后不能直接接这一完整分句，且这里表达目的。
in order to 后应接动词原形，不能直接接 we could...。

cloze.text: Before a class debate, I wrote a long speech supporting a daily reading break. My partner asked what a classmate who disagreed might say. I added one sentence: 'Some students may worry about homework time.' Then I repeated my own reasons. My partner said I had 〔1〕_____ the concern without answering it. I went back to the plan. A reading break could be short, and we could try it for a month before deciding whether to continue. These details did not 〔2〕_____ that everyone would agree, but they showed how the concern might be addressed. I also removed the claim that reading breaks always improve every student's marks. We had no 〔3〕_____ for such a wide promise. The revised speech was shorter, yet it made the disagreement clearer. I learned that a strong argument does not need to 〔4〕_____ other views. It should respond to them and keep its claims within what the reasons can 〔5〕_____.
items: mentioned
solved
forgotten
without answering it.
只是提到了顾虑，尚未作回应。
solved 与尚未回答相矛盾。
前文已经写出那条顾虑，不是完全忘记。
guarantee
discuss
remember
everyone would agree
短期试行等细节不能保证所有人赞成。
discuss 在这里不能直接搭配 that everyone would agree 来表达保证。
remember 表记得，不对应方案细节与未来认同的关系。
evidence
permission
space
such a wide promise.
保证所有人成绩总提高需要广泛证据，文中没有。
有无许可不能证明该成绩承诺为真。
不是篇幅空间不足，而是承诺超出了依据。
hide
understand
answer
It should respond to them
后句要求回应其他观点，说明不应把它们隐藏。
理解其他观点并非强论证不需要做的事。
后句明确应该回应，不能选不需要回答。
support
cost
replace
keep its claims within
论点范围应受理由能支持的范围约束。
cost 是花费，不能表达理由支持主张的关系。
replace 表替换，不是论据与主张的关系。

reading.text:
WHAT OUR BOOK SURVEY CAN TELL US
The student library team asked forty volunteers from two Year 9 classes about reading during the previous week. Twenty-four said they had read a printed book, and eighteen said they had read a digital book. Ten reported both. The categories were not separate, so adding twenty-four and eighteen does not give the number of different readers. The team also asked which format students preferred, but several said their choice depended on the book and situation. These volunteers were not a random sample of the whole school. The team plans to invite other year groups and ask about access to books before recommending changes. The current results are a starting point for questions, rather than a final description of everyone's habits.
items: Why should 24 and 18 not be added to count different readers?
Ten students appear in both groups.
There were only eighteen volunteers in total.
All printed books were also digital books.
Ten reported both.
两组有十人重叠，直接相加会重复计数。
总样本是四十名，不是十八名。
both 指有十位读者读两类，不是所有纸书都有电子版。
How many volunteers reported reading at least one of the two formats?
Thirty-two.
Forty-two.
Ten.
Twenty-four said they had read a printed book, and eighteen said they had read a digital book. Ten reported both.
24加18再减去重叠的10，得到32名不同读者。
42把两组都出现的十人重复计算。
10只统计读两类的人，漏掉只读一类的人。
Which statement about preferences is supported?
Some students' preferences depended on context.
All volunteers always preferred printed books.
Every student had to choose one format forever.
their choice depended on the book and situation.
一部分人的选择随书和情境而变化。
All 和 always 超出原文，原文没有一致固定偏好。
一次调查不要求永久只使用一种形式。
What is the main limit of the survey?
Its volunteers from two classes cannot represent the whole school.
It collected no responses at all.
It proves that access to books never matters.
These volunteers were not a random sample of the whole school.
样本来自两班志愿者，不能直接代表全校。
原文有四十名参与者及多项结果。
团队还准备调查获取书籍的条件，未证明其无关。

reading.text: After receiving comments on a first draft, some students replace every sentence with phrases they think sound more advanced. The result may be longer but less clear. Revision is more useful when the writer can name the problem a change is meant to solve. If an invitation lacks a meeting place, a complicated opening will not repair the missing information. If an opinion has only one reason, adding several linking words will not create a second reason. Language choices matter, but they should serve the message. One practical method is to make two checks: first read as the person receiving the message and list what is still unclear; then read sentence by sentence for language problems. The first draft is not evidence that a writer cannot write. It is material the writer can learn to improve.
items: What problem can replacing every sentence create?
The draft may become less clear.
It always adds every missing task point.
It removes the need to think about the reader.
longer but less clear.
追求高级表达可能增加长度却降低清晰度。
更换句式不会自动补齐任务信息。
全文强调从收件者角度检查，不能省略。
What would directly improve an invitation without a meeting place?
Adding the missing location.
Using a more complicated opening only.
Replacing every linking word.
a complicated opening will not repair the missing information.
缺的是地点，直接修正应补入地点。
复杂开头不提供缺失的地点。
连接词变化也不能自动提供地点。
Which order does the writer recommend?
Check the message for the reader, then check language sentence by sentence.
Check spelling only, then submit without reading the task.
Copy advanced phrases, then remove specific details.
first read as the person receiving the message
先检查沟通信息，再逐句检查语言。
只查拼写会漏掉任务信息，且与两轮检查不符。
文章批评无目的堆高级表达，并未建议删掉具体信息。
Which statement best captures the writer's view of a first draft?
It is something that can be improved through purposeful revision.
It fixes a student's writing ability permanently.
It should be made longer regardless of the task.
It is material the writer can learn to improve.
结尾明确把初稿视为可以学习改进的材料。
原文否认初稿证明某人不会写作这种永久标签。
长度不是修订目标，改动应服务具体任务。

task.text:
REVISION WORKSHOP
Before the workshop, bring your first draft and the task instructions. In the first round, a partner checks whether the reader has enough information to act or understand your view. In the second round, you check sentence structure, tense and word choice. Mark one change and write the reason for it. Keep both drafts so you can see what improved. A peer's tick records a check, not an official examination mark.
items: Bring the first draft and the task _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
instructions
bring your first draft and the task instructions.
修订须对照原任务要求，不是只看初稿文字。
The second round checks language, including sentence _____, tense and word choice. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
structure
you check sentence structure, tense and word choice.
原文列出句子结构、时态和用词三项。
For one marked change, write its _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
reason
Mark one change and write the reason for it.
不仅标出改动，还要说明改动理由。

writing.stem: 班级讨论“修改作文时，是否应把每一句都换成更高级的表达”。写约90—110词的英文发言稿，表明观点，给出两个理由，回应“复杂句越多分数就越高”这一顾虑，并提出一种具体的修改办法。立场可以不同，但理由须连贯，不能保证考试分数。
writing.model: I do not think we should replace every sentence with a more advanced expression. First, a clear sentence can already do its job, while an unfamiliar phrase may introduce mistakes. Second, changing language alone cannot add missing information or a second reason. Some classmates worry that more complex sentences always bring higher marks. Useful variety matters, but sentences still need to be accurate and serve the task. I suggest checking the message before the language: ask a partner what is unclear, then revise one problem at a time. Finally, explain why each important change makes the draft better.
points: 两个清楚且有展开的理由
回应复杂句与分数的关系这一顾虑
writing.organisation: 立场、理由、对顾虑的回应与建议连贯衔接，避免只列口号。
writing.language: 检查复杂句是否准确、代词指代是否清楚；以表达任务信息为目的使用句型变化。
writing.format: 发言稿语气适合班级讨论，篇幅符合要求
writing.pitfall: 不要求采用参考立场或句式；不能把复杂句数量与分数作绝对等同。
